reason:
Checked through the transfer lens against cand_exp39_ef.parquet (label 1=TP, 2=FP), edges_exp39.parquet and CONTEXT.
(a) Node multiplier: not involved. Node counts are identical in all 135 confirmation videos, and the gain is purely edge J.
(b) 44b6 crop redundancy: this inflates the claimed significance, not the effect. The 12 non-tied 44b6 videos fall into 5 leak groups (5 W / 0 L / 13 T by cluster, one-sided p 0.031, not 0.003). 44b6 contributes only 29 evaluable stitched edges (26 TP / 3 FP, precision 0.897). The evidence is therefore essentially one embryo (6bba: 245 TP / 16 FP) plus a weak consistent sign on the other.
(c) In-sample edge net: this is the real risk, and it is only partly answered. All 6,956 ILP end->start candidates are edges the relink rejected. Their median displacement is 9.3 um against a 1.8 um true step. The final graph has almost no scored edges beyond 7 um, so this is the regime the linker is least tested in. Two leakage signatures show up there:
  - In-sample precision RISES with displacement: <5 um 0.75, 5-7 um 0.80, 7-9 um 0.92, 9-12 um 0.96, 12-15 um 0.95. That is physically counter-intuitive, and it fits a network that memorised offset detections of the annotated lineages it was trained on.
  - The share of candidates touching an annotated cell rises 4x with ILP p in 6bba (2.4% at p 0.5-0.7 vs 10.1% at p > 0.9) but stays flat in 44b6 (1.3-2.5%), where training labels are scarce.
  The same p-vs-annotation enrichment exists for ordinary final edges (6bba 2.6-3.1% -> 7.6%, i.e. 2.5x), so it is a generic in-sample property of the edge net and slightly stronger for the stitch. The only out-of-sample datapoint for 'trust the ILP where the relink disagrees' is relink-off: +0.0014 local edge term, -0.002 on the LB. That is negative evidence, although relink-off competes head-to-head with relink edges, whereas the stitch only fills pairs left open on both ends.
Why the sign still survives: a stitched edge only needs precision above J/(1+J) ~0.48 to help. In-sample precision is 0.93 overall (selection 0.915, confirmation 0.948), and even the weakest in-sample slices (p 0.6-0.7: 0.72; <7 um: ~0.79) sit well above break-even. Out-of-sample precision would have to roughly halve before the rule loses, and the loss would then be bounded at about -0.001 (roughly 300 evaluable additions per 199 videos). Generic edge quality also transfers: local exp39 0.914 is BELOW public 0.948, so the test embryo is not harder.
Conclusion: the sign very likely holds on unseen embryos, but the magnitude does not. The +0.0021 is an in-sample number on long edges and should be discounted to about +0.0005..+0.0012. It is below LB resolution and cannot be attributed inside a bundle. Its value also exists only because the edge filter creates breaks (150 -> 399; about +0.0007 without ef), so it rides entirely on probe 29, which tests the same in-sample-ILP bet on a different (shorter-edge) subset.
fix_if_any:
1) Hard-condition shipping on probe 29 (exp49 >= ~0.950). If ef does not transfer, drop the stitch; with no filter, its ~+0.0007 in-sample would be about +0.0003 out of sample and not worth a slot.
2) Keep the measured placement (after linefit and ef, before divinsert) and st_all or st_p06 as in the refined change. A p threshold is NOT a leakage hedge, because the annotation enrichment is concentrated at high p.
3) If a GPU slot allows, test transfer directly instead of trusting the in-sample lab. Rescore the stitch candidates with an embryo-held-out edge net: train SimpleNodeTransformer on 44b6 only, score 6bba (the B34 2-fold-by-embryo setup, or a geometry-only refit in under 1 h on friend A's GPU). Recompute stitch precision on 6bba with held-out p (ILP re-solve or p-thresholded candidates). Ship only if held-out precision is >= 0.7 on the 7-15 um bins.
4) Cheap GT-free hedge: add max_um 12 (the kernel knob exists). This drops the 12-15 um tail of 728 candidates (39 TP / 2 FP in-sample), which is the most out-of-distribution displacement, at a cost of about 0.0002 local.
5) Count 44b6 by leak group in the tie-aware gate, as in the refined protocol, and declare the gate change as post hoc in CONTEXT.md.
realistic_public_gain: +0.000..+0.0015 on public/private, point estimate ~+0.0008, and only if probe 29 shows the edge filter transfers. The worst case, out-of-sample precision on the 9-12 um candidates collapsing below ~0.5, is about -0.001 (bounded because only ~1-5% of added edges are evaluable). It cannot be seen in a solo probe at 3-decimal resolution, so it belongs only in the ef bundle, and it contributes nothing meaningful toward the 0.97 target.
